name: Fuchū (Hiroshima, Japan, town)
description: A navy field charged at the centre with the Fuchū town emblem in white: a triquetra of three interlocking curved strokes.
history: Municipal flag of Fuchū, a town in Hiroshima Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 8 May 1970.

features.role: Fuchū town emblem — a triquetra of three interlocking curved strokes
